_comment: Functional graphemes for Russian. A consonant followed by the soft sign ь is one grapheme (мать → м а ть, /m a tʲ/). Vowel letters е ё ю я after a consonant map to the vowel alone (the consonant carries the palatalisation), so they are single graphemes; word-initial or post-vowel е ё ю я stand for /j/ + vowel (two phonemes) and do not segment 1:1. The hard sign ъ is kept as a letter. See data-prep/docs/grapheme-phoneme-alignment.md.
